problems.evidence: Test: `expect(EMPTY_CONTACT_FORM).toEqual({ name: '', email: '', company: '', topic: '', message: '' })`. The task adds "Company size" as an optional field, and the plan says: "EMPTY_CONTACT_FORM becomes {name:'', email:'', company:'', companySize:'', topic:'', message:''}".
problems.fix: Expect `{ name: '', email: '', company: '', companySize: '', topic: '', message: '' }`, and also check COMPANY_SIZE_OPTIONS.

problems.test: submitContact > valid submit succeeds, clears values, makes no request
problems.evidence: Test: `expect(result.values).toEqual({ name: '', email: '', company: '', topic: '', message: '' })`. The plan says: "the success result's values equal EMPTY_CONTACT_FORM", and EMPTY_CONTACT_FORM now includes `companySize: ''`.

problems.test: public files > sitemap.xml lists the five pages
problems.evidence: Test expects exactly five locs: /, /services, /training, /about, /contact. The task says: "add /systems and /engagements to the prerendered pages and to public/sitemap.xml (seven pages)".
problems.fix: Expect the seven URLs, adding https://thebayesgroup.com/systems and https://thebayesgroup.com/engagements.

problems.evidence: Test expects exactly five custom-development item names. The task says: "In custom-development add the item 'Agentic systems and multi-system integration'", and the plan says "Append to custom-development a 6th item".
problems.fix: Expect the five existing names followed by 'Agentic systems and multi-system integration'.

problems.test: services page rendering > section %s ends with a Typical engagement line
problems.evidence: Test requires the section text to end with `Typical engagement: …`, after the last item's description. The task says: "Each section header is two columns on desktop: the photo … and, on the other, the eyebrow, h2, a two-sentence intro paragraph and the 'Typical engagement' line", and items follow in a grid. So the line comes before the items in DOM order. The new item also ends with a 'See how we build' link.
problems.fix: Check that the section contains a 'Typical engagement: {typicalEngagement}' line, for example inside the section header, without requiring it to be the last text of the section.

problems.test: contact form field style > only fields with an error are aria-invalid
problems.evidence: `company: f.getByLabelText(/^Company\b/)`. The task requires a new `<label for="companySize">Company size</label>`, which also matches /^Company\b/. getByLabelText therefore finds two controls and throws.
problems.fix: Use `/^Company(?! size)\b/`, or an exact match, for the company field. Optionally also assert that companySize is never aria-invalid.

problems.test: contact form field style > Required is shown the same way on every required field
problems.evidence: It calls the same `controls(form)` helper with `getByLabelText(/^Company\b/)`. That throws once the task's required 'Company size' label exists.
problems.fix: Disambiguate the Company label query (e.g. `/^Company(?! size)/`) and include companySize as an optional field in the map.

problems.test: footer content > footer on %s shows only wordmark, line, nav and copyright
problems.evidence: The test strips only `a, nav, svg` and then requires the remaining text to be '' or 'The Bayes Group'. The task's footer has "a 'Services' column (…)" and "a 'Company' column (About, Contact)". The natural column headings 'Services' and 'Company' are non-link text, so they would make the test fail unless every column is wrapped in a <nav>.
problems.fix: Also allow the column headings 'Services' and 'Company' in the remaining text (or strip headings), while still forbidding the TAGLINE and duplicate footer lines.
